# Security Policy

## This fork (Bwoah My Pi)

This repository is a personal fork of
[Oh My Pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi). It has no separate public
release or support commitment.

### Supported Versions

Only the current `main` branch is considered for best-effort security fixes.
Older fork commits and releases do not receive guaranteed backports.

### Reporting a Vulnerability

- For a vulnerability introduced by or specific to this fork, open a
  [private security advisory](https://github.com/btimothy-har/bwoah-my-pi/security/advisories/new).
- For a vulnerability that also affects upstream OMP, follow the
  [upstream security policy](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/security/policy)
  and mention the fork when relevant.

Include reproduction steps, affected versions or commits, and relevant details.
Never disclose a security vulnerability in a public issue.

### Response

Reports are handled on a best-effort basis without a response-time guarantee.
The upstream OMP maintainers do not maintain or support this fork.

---

The following retained policy describes upstream OMP, not this fork.

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release is supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

To report a security issue, either:

- Email can1357 directly, or
- Open a [private security advisory](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/security/advisories/new) on GitHub

Include steps to reproduce and any relevant details. Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

## Response

Reports are handled on a best-effort basis. You can expect an initial acknowledgment within a few days.
